At the same time, it is the intent of the Township to regulate advertising, by temporary signs and structures, in order to prevent potential traffic hazards, to proscribe intrusive and unpleasant formats for expressions, to eliminate debris that settles in drains and ditches, to eliminate unsightliness and litter, and to otherwise enhance the appearance of the community. 1002: GENERAL A.
